context: A mom answers her young son's questions about an old story
purpose: Teach: 易い/あらわれ/混じっ/密か/つねに/ぜひとも/すむ/誘惑

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ねえママ、あの昔のお話、もう一回して！使い易いお布団に入ったから。
lines.en: Hey Mom, tell me that old story again! I'm in my comfy easy-to-use futon now.
lines.style: Child tugging at mother's sleeve, eager and snuggled into the futon waiting for storytime.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: いいわよ。森の奥に、密かに暮らす一匹の狐がいたの。
lines.en: Sure. Deep in the forest, there lived a fox in secret.
lines.style: Warm storytelling voice, soft and slow, settling onto the edge of the bed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: その狐、人間の前にあらわれたことあるの？
lines.en: Did the fox ever appear in front of humans?
lines.style: Wide-eyed curiosity, leaning forward with both hands gripping the blanket.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ええ。月の光に銀色が混じった夜、村の少年の前に姿を見せたのよ。
lines.en: Yes. On a night when silver mixed with the moonlight, it appeared before a village boy.
lines.style: Hushed, drawing the listener in with a near-whisper, eyes twinkling.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: その子、こわくなかったの？はやく教えて！
lines.en: Wasn't the boy scared? Hurry, tell me!
lines.style: Bouncing with excitement, demanding more and kicking little feet under the covers.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 怖がってたけど、その狐はつねに優しい目をしてたの。だから逃げなかった。
lines.en: He was scared, but the fox always had kind eyes, so he didn't run away.
lines.style: Reassuring maternal tone with a gentle smile, smoothing the child's hair back.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: でもね、狐には化けて村人を騙したいっていう誘惑もあったのよ。
lines.en: But the fox also had the temptation to shapeshift and trick the villagers.
lines.style: Lowering voice for dramatic effect, raising one eyebrow to build suspense.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ええっ、それでどうなったの？気がすむまで聞きたいから、ぜひとも続けて！
lines.en: What?! What happened then? I want to hear until I'm satisfied, please continue!
lines.style: Grabbing mom's hand, refusing to sleep and pleading for the rest of the tale.
